query:
SELECT c.id, c.agentId, c.createdAt, COUNT(m.id) as messageCount 
FROM conversations c 
LEFT JOIN messages m ON c.id = m.conversationId 
WHERE c.userId = (SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = '409735339@qq.com')
GROUP BY c.id, c.agentId, c.createdAt
ORDER BY c.createdAt DESC
